# RFP ACT SACT 26-90

Request for Proposal for **Contractor Support for Quantum Zero Beacon Project (QZBP)**.

Estimated Period of Performance: **4 January 2027 to 31 December 2027**.

**Bid closing date**: Bids shall be received at HQ SACT, Purchasing and Contracting Office, **no later than 12 November 2026, 0900 hours**, Eastern Time, Norfolk, Virginia, USA. No bids shall be accepted after this date and time. No hard copy proposals will be accepted. Please see Proposal Submission (paragraph 12) for more details.

[**Click here to open RFP ACT SACT 26-90 Amendment #1**](https://www.act.nato.int/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/rfp026090_amdt1.pdf)

[**Mandatory Price Proposal**](https://www.act.nato.int/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/rfp026090_mpv.xlsx) \| [**Annex B (Grading Matrix)**](https://www.act.nato.int/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/rfp026090_annex-b.xlsx) \| [**Annex C (Supporting Documents Template)**](https://www.act.nato.int/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/rfp026090_annex-c.docx) \| [**Security Aspects**](https://www.act.nato.int/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/rf026090_security-aspects.pdf) \| [**Security Clause**](https://www.act.nato.int/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/rfp026090_security-clause.pdf)
